events.name: HOKA Val d'Aran by UTMB
events.gpxStatus: 2027 official race pages now explicitly list GPX download panels. VDA 163K, TDL 75K and PDA 55K have stored direct URL candidates, but no binary could be fetched here for XML/trackpoint validation. Important version warning: VDA stored URL is in a directory labelled 'GPX 2026' despite filename VDA_2027; do not certify it as a verified 2027 GPX. An independent 2027 course analysis reports TDL file hash and measurements, but this is not a substitute for importing the organizer's bytes. CDH, EXP, SKY, SKY Promises and Vielha 10K also need current 2027 direct files; older 2026 files remain preserved as historical versions.
events.followUp: Obtain direct 2027 GPX downloads for all seven race courses, preferably via organizer/UTMB page or participant export; validate binary bytes and replace none of the historical files.
events.retentionRule: Never remove/overwrite prior-year GPX. Keep each version with year, source, checksum and validation status; promote new version only after its bytes have been downloaded and checked.
